Get ready for FALLENS!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 20 (Formerly, [[Polluted Wasteland II|Nuclear]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Toxic''' is a fast enemy that appears in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. It has a high health and a fast speed. It has one ability where upon death, it creates an acidic puddle that rapidly heals any enemy that walks through it. It also has the [[Corpse (Attribute)|Corpse]] attribute, making it turn into a [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] upon death. The '''Toxic''' replaces the [[Fallen]] in [[Oops! All slimes!]] [[Challenge Maps|Challenge Map]]. The '''Toxic''' could be spawned by the [[Nuclear Monster]]. It also could have been spawned by the [[Mystery]] in [[Polluted Wasteland II]], starting from Wave 21. ==Appearance== The '''Toxic''' has glowing light green skin and a dark green torso. Glowing green veins can be seen on its head and arms. It emits green pulses and particles from its torso and its head twitches when it runs. ==Mutation== ===Nuclear=== {| class="tds-table align-center mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="width: 300px; margin: 0 auto" ! colspan="2" |Mutation |- !Percentage !Increase |- |5% |50 |- !Wave !Health |- |12 |1,050 |- |13 |1,100 |- |14 |1,150 |- |15 |1,200 |- |16 |1,250 |- |17 |1,300 |- |18 |1,350 |- |19 |1,400 |- |20 |1,450 |- |21 |1,500 |- |22 |1,550 |- |23 |1,600 |- |24 |1,650 |- |25 |1,700 |} ===Oops! |- |38 |344 |- |39 |352 |- |40 |360 |} ==Strategy== *Multiple high DPS towers, like the [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]], and [[Engineer]] are recommended to take down the '''Toxic'''. **The [[Accelerator]]'s overcharge does not increase when it is dealing damage to an enemy's regenerated health, making it more effective against enemies which had their health regenerated. *The [[Commander]] can be very useful at increasing the DPS of your towers, allowing you to deal with the '''Toxics''' quicker. **The [[Commander]] can also be useful against enemies that are healed by the '''Toxic's''' acidic puddle. *As this enemy is quite fast, slowing towers like the [[Electroshocker]] and [[Sledger]] can be very useful against this. *Be careful of the '''Toxic's''' ''Acid Bath'' ability as it can rapidly heal other enemies, making it a much bigger threat when there are large groups of enemies. **It is recommended to kill the '''Toxic''' as soon as possible so it does not heal enemies that are already damaged. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseToxic.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) ==Trivia== *The [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] used to improperly mention this enemy as a [[Fallen]]. **This was because the [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]]'s dialogue for [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode was not changed in [[Polluted Wasteland II]] before the [[v1.4.2|Halloween 2022 Update]]. *The '''Toxic''', despite being an acidic enemy, does not have any immunity to the [[Toxic Gunner]]. *The '''Toxic''' is somewhat similar in terms of looks to the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Toxic|Toxic]] from ''Tower Battles''. *The '''Toxic''' may be based on the Toxic Zombie from ''The Final Stand 2'', due to both of them having an ability to create a puddle of acid, which heals enemies walking on it. ==Update History== *'''29 July 2022''' - [[v1.3.0]] **'''Toxic''' added. *'''23
